_comment: The one list of CPython versions this repository supports. Read by scripts/python_support.py, scripts/tool_locks.py and tests/test_python_support.py; the workflow defaults and the README repeat it and the tests hold them equal. security_end is the end of CPython security support (the devguide's end-of-life month, taken as the last day of that month); bugfix_end is the end of bugfix releases (null when it ended before this list began). Source: https://devguide.python.org/versions/ and PEP 664, 693, 719, 745, 790. Drop a version here, and from every default the tests name, once its security_end has passed.

tool_locks.newest_reason: scripts/tool_locks.py prunes the hash locks to wheels for CPython up to this minor; PyPI has no cp315 wheel yet for some locked packages (see the wheel report in CHANGELOG.md), so security.yml and agent-scan.yml support up to 3.14.

grace.reason: The hash locks for pip-audit and Semgrep still resolve from 3.10; 3.10 reached end of life on 2026-10-01. Relock from 3.11 with scripts/tool_locks.py and delete this entry.
